proposals.title: Item 4 – Stockholder Proposal to Adopt a Policy to Require an Independent Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board adopt and by-law policy requiring the Chairman of the Board to be an independent director, with succession and excusal provisions.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST each of these proposals

proposals.title: Item 5 – Stockholder Proposal to Provide a Report on the Company's Lobbying Policies and Practices
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management, on behalf of Paula C. Sager, Victor A. Kovner, Lewis Blaustein, The Oregon Environmental Council, Plymouth Congregational Church of Seattle, Persephone LLC, and Mayberry LLC
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing the Company's lobbying policies, direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots payments, model-legislation organization payments, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal, which is identified as Item 5 in the proxy materials
